name: Muxapp Artist & Music Ranking SEO Pro
author: Emmanuelisdkz Akanbi

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Muxapp SEO in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Open Content Mapping and select the public post types used by your music and artist content.
  5. Select the metadata keys and save the mapping.
  6. Open SEO Output to enable or disable metadata, Open Graph, structured data, and sitemap output.
sections.changelog:
2.1.8

  • Hardened admin input handling for WordPress.org security checks.
  • Preserved existing SEO mapping and output functionality.

2.1.7

  • Sanitized and unslashed all mapped POST inputs before processing.
  • Added nonce-protected handling for admin save actions.
  • Replaced direct database metadata discovery with WordPress APIs.
  • Replaced raw JSON-LD script output with wp_print_inline_script_tag().
  • Removed direct GET access for the public sitemap route.
  • Fixed admin asset page detection.
  • Shortened the readme short description to WordPress.org limits.

2.1.6

  • Updated the public display name to Muxapp Artist & Music Ranking SEO Pro.
  • Standardized the plugin folder and main file to the requested muxapp-artist-music-google-seo slug.
  • Updated Plugin URI to https://www.muxapp.name.ng/.
  • Hardened JSON-LD output for safe script-element embedding.
  • Preserved content mapping, metadata, Open Graph, structured data, sitemap, and robots.txt functionality.
  • Kept the plugin self-contained without license-server or subscription requirements.
sections.description:
Artist and music SEO tools for metadata, Open Graph, structured data, canonical URLs, and XML sitemaps.

Features

  • Public custom post-type discovery and content mapping.
  • Metadata-key discovery and mapping for music title, artist, featured artist, audio URL, description, canonical URL, and Open Graph image.
  • Meta description and canonical URL output for configured content.
  • Open Graph title, description, URL, type, and image output.
  • MusicRecording structured data using mapped music and artist metadata.
  • Dynamic XML sitemap for selected public post types.
  • Sitemap entry in the site’s public robots.txt output.
  • Muxapp Services shortcode.
  • Standalone operation without a license server or subscription requirement.
